final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT tr.ordertypedist, AVG(sf.optvolrt) as avg_optvolrt, COUNT(*) as record_count FROM sentimentandfundamentals sf JOIN transactionrecord tr ON sf.transref = tr.transreg GROUP BY tr.ordertypedist), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_optvolrt) as avg_of_avg_optvolrt FROM step1 WHERE avg_optvolrt IS NOT NULL), step3 AS (SELECT s1.ordertypedist, s1.avg_optvolrt, s1.record_count, s1.avg_optvolrt - s2.avg_of_avg_optvolrt as diff FROM step1 s1 CROSS JOIN step2 s2 WHERE s2.avg_of_avg_optvolrt IS NOT NULL AND s1.avg_optvolrt > s2.avg_of_avg_optvolrt) SELECT AVG(avg_optvolrt) as avg_second_col, AVG(record_count) as avg_third_col, AVG(diff) as avg_fourth_col FROM step3
